challenge.results: The definition requires the Copyright INRIA marking in this distribution. The operative paragraph names the OCaml Core System and INRIA. Its two qualifying cases are the unmodified Core System as distributed by INRIA and a modified version distributed under clause 2. The proposed substitutions would change the subject or distributor.

limitations: The finding covers this repository file and its definition of the Core System. OCaml release-tag and package provenance remain open. Individual file markings and other components require separate inspection.
The permission concerns the stated linking and resulting executable distribution circumstances. The final sentence preserves other grounds for LGPL coverage.
